## History

Julia Bell is a classmate of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at school. She joined in the warm welcome given to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decided to return to the classroom, and she later participated in the excited preparations for a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert organized by the new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), to raise money for a school flag.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--julia-bell.md)

Julia Bell is a schoolmate and friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). The two girls share friendly tokens with one another during their time together at school.
